title: Fast Forever
notes: No standalone article ("Fast X: Part 2" redirects to the franchise article). Release history: 2025, then 2026, then March 2026, then April 2027; Oct 2025 WSJ: "the film had no release date and was facing potential cancelation"; now 17 March 2028. Aug 2026: Diesel said filming would begin that December. Volatile; treat as unreleased. Also in Future: Hobbs & Reyes (in development, no date), an untitled stand-alone film, an untitled female-led spin-off, a Diesel-directed short "which will take place chronologically before the final film" (Mar 2025), and four Peacock series in development (May 2026). None has a date.

in_universe.label: Not yet placed (unreleased)

release.note: Wikipedia: "In January 2026, it was announced that the film is officially titled Fast Forever, and was scheduled to be released on March 17, 2028." Film overview: date11 = {{Start date|2028|03|17}}
